name: Lorebind
author: MarshalX
description: A browser for every item in the game, and the name service every other addon subscribes to.

preview.alt: the Lorebind window browsing the game's epic armor: a grid of item art, each square edged in the game's own colour for its tier, with one item's record open under it

companionReasons.satchel: draws the bags, bank and mailbox this names the items in, and totals them at the prices it publishes
companionReasons.ledgerline: records what the Merchant is asking, which is the other half of what an item is worth

keybinds.label: Show or hide the item codex

settings.label: Learn item names from loot rolls the group answers
Describe any item another addon has marked, on hover
How many item squares to draw at once
